items.title: Write reviewable cli-engine English translation execution plan
items.context: Audit packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts for Chinese-language surfaces and create an English execution document with per-item Chinese-to-English translation results for reviewer approval. Do not change CLI source in this story.
items.userSees: The document opens with "# CLI Engine English Open-Source Surface Execution Plan" and includes a "Translation Review Table" section.

happy.desc: The new execution document exists and states the English-only open-source policy, staged migration plan, verification commands, and reviewer workflow.

edge.desc: The document includes a Chinese source to proposed English translation table for cli-engine.ts review, including representative public CLI help/schema/error/hint surfaces.

adversarial.desc: This documentation story does not modify packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts or the existing untracked lattice-codex command boundary document.
